votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of November 19, 2024 and the formal meeting minutes of January 7, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved the minutes from the November 19, 2024 work session and the January 7, 2025 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer items B1 and B2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on two grant applications — a DEQ Drinking Water loan for the 4th Avenue Well and a Bureau of Emergency Medical Services per capita grant — and referred both to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 11 of 2025, amending the final budget of Salt Lake City, including the employment staffing document, for Fiscal Year 2024-2025, addressing all remaining requests except item A-2.
votes.description: The Council adopted Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2024-25, covering infrastructure on the Fleet Block, City vehicles including a Justice Bus, Great Salt Lake watershed protection, and other items, while excluding the Graphic Design position request (item A-2) for consideration during annual budget deliberations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 10 of 2025, approving a $75,000 loan for Policy Kings Brewery, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $75,000 EDLF loan to Policy Kings Brewery, LLC — Utah's first Black-owned brewery — relocating to 79 West 900 South, intended to create 15 new jobs and retain 15 existing jobs.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 04 of 2025, extending the time period to comply with the conditions in Ordinance 06 of 2023 for an additional 6 months.
votes.description: The Council extended by six months the deadline for the property at approximately 704 East 900 South to satisfy conditions of the 2023 rezoning ordinance from R-2 to SNB zoning.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2025, Enacting a Temporary Land Use Regulation – Public School Development Standards.
votes.description: The Council adopted a Temporary Land Use Regulation changing zoning standards for K-12 public school development in the Public Lands District.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Mark Kittrell as the Salt Lake City Attorney.
votes.description: The Council confirmed the Mayor's appointment of Mark Kittrell to serve as Salt Lake City Attorney.

The Council approved all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for HUD grants and consolidated plan, an alley vacation, Grant Holding Account Batch No. 3, and three board appointments/reappointments.
